definitions.accuracy: correct/n scored units; unknown and unresolved are incorrect; bsb uses the C1 reader reference
definitions.yer_item: all slots correct; all 59 items included, including 28 zero-slot items
definitions.owner39: scored heads only; breathing excluded on one card; joint = base and all scored heads
definitions.owner39_pool: 33 card-reads, retaining repeated cards once per Opus read; each head uses its eligible card-reads
definitions.variance: official scorer agreement; owner unknown/unknown is not confirmed agreement; accuracy differences use the same overlap
definitions.changes: per scored field/slot and joint/item; unresolved answers count as wrong and remain in denominators
definitions.Sol_total: input + output; cached input is part of input; reasoning is part of output; do not add either twice
definitions.cost_run_denominator: assigned items including controls; r3 includes only disputed items plus controls
definitions.cost_arm_denominator: unique scored bed items excluding controls; S1 is one reader, S2 is r1+r2+r3
definitions.weekly: 10080-minute bucket; before/after are endpoint probes; delta_sum sums within-run deltas, excludes intervening work
definitions.credits: null before balance or spent means unavailable, not zero; ratios with zero or unavailable denominators are null
definitions.meters: Sol rollout tokens/limits and Opus usage-log tokens are separate; no conversion
definitions.build: launcher session id mapped to rollout; current B4 is a timestamped lower-bound snapshot; excluded from completed build totals

accuracy.reader: Sol r1 on Opus partial pooled
Sol r2 on Opus partial pooled
Sol S2 on Opus partial pooled
